sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: GSM Wizard Digital Payments Limited (GSM Wizard PayTech Solutions) is a leading fintech company based in Nnewi, Anambra State, dedicated to revolutionizing digital financial services across Nigeria. We understand the unique challenges facing Nigerian businesses and individuals in accessing convenient, secure payment solutions. Our platform leverages cutting-edge technology to deliver instant bill payments, mobile top-ups, data subscriptions, and comprehensive digital financial services. With a commitment to financial inclusion and innovation, we're bridging the gap between traditional banking and the digital economy, making financial transactions accessible to everyone from small market traders to large enterprises. Our secure infrastructure and customer-first approach have made us a trusted name in Nigeria's rapidly growing fintech landscape.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Digital Payment Solutions: Instant bill payments for electricity, cable TV, internet subscriptions, and more. Process payments securely with real-time confirmations.

Mobile Airtime & Data: Purchase airtime and data bundles for all major Nigerian networks (MTN, Glo, Airtel, 9mobile) at competitive rates with instant delivery.

Bulk SMS Services: Reach your customers effectively with our reliable bulk SMS platform. Perfect for marketing campaigns, notifications, and customer engagement.

Wallet Services: Secure digital wallet for storing funds, making instant transfers, and managing your transactions efficiently.

Agent Banking: Become a GSM Wizard agent and earn commissions by providing essential financial services in your community.

Business Solutions: Customized payment integration APIs for businesses looking to accept digital payments and automate their financial operations.

Education Payments: Simplified payment solutions for exam pins, result checkers, and other educational services across Nigeria.

sections.name: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.copy:
How do I create an account with GSM Wizard? Simply visit our website at gsmwizard.org and click on 'Register'. Fill in your details, verify your phone number, and you're ready to start transacting within minutes.

Is my money safe with GSM Wizard? Absolutely. We use advanced encryption and security protocols to protect all transactions. Our platform is built with bank-level security standards, and we're regulated to operate digital payment services in Nigeria.

What payment methods do you accept? We accept bank transfers, card payments, and USSD transfers from all major Nigerian banks. You can easily fund your wallet using any of these convenient methods.

How quickly are transactions processed? Most transactions are instant. Airtime, data, and bill payments are typically completed within seconds. In rare cases of network delays from service providers, transactions may take up to 5 minutes.

Can I become a GSM Wizard agent? Yes! We're always looking for reliable partners across Nigeria. Contact us to learn about our agent program, commission structure, and requirements.

Do you offer business solutions? Yes, we provide API integration for businesses of all sizes. Whether you run an e-commerce platform or a retail business, we can help you accept digital payments seamlessly.

What if I have a transaction issue? Our customer support team is available to resolve any issues promptly. Contact us via phone or WhatsApp, and we'll investigate and resolve your concern quickly.

Are there transaction limits? Transaction limits depend on your account verification level. Fully verified accounts enjoy higher limits suitable for business operations.
